appearances.title: UGG joins video, depth, and camera pose in one model
appearances.summary: UGG is a single diffusion model for video generation, depth, and camera pose, treating missing geometry as something to generate. It reports lower camera-trajectory error than Geo4D on ScanNet++ and can search several 3D interpretations for the most consistent one when observations are sparse.
